A PhD was earned at the University of Minnesota.

Nguyen is an Associate Professor of Educational Leadership and Policy Analysis at the [University of Missouri](https://cehd.missouri.edu/person/tuan-nguyen/), holding a PhD from Vanderbilt University. Nguyen's website](https://tuan-d-nguyen.github.io/home).

Huynh's website](https://nghiemhuynh.com/).

Luyen is an Assistant Professor of Electrical Engineering at the [University of North Texas](https://facultyinfo.unt.edu/faculty-profile?profile=htl0039), affiliated with the [Applied Electromagnetics Laboratory](https://engineering.unt.edu/ee/research/labs/aeml/). Research covers microwave ablation antennas for medical therapies, reconfigurable beam-steering phased-array antennas, and self-interference cancellation. Work builds on a PhD from Wisconsin-Madison.

Thuy D. Nguyen is a Clinical Associate Professor of Marketing at the [University of North Texas](https://facultyinfo.unt.edu/faculty-profile?profile=tdn0003). Recipient of ACLS Frederick Burkhardt and ACLS Project Development fellowships.
